_comment: Combat tuning. Every number here is a first guess, not balance. Energy values are in whole points unless the key ends in _milli (thousandths of a point). The skills themselves (actions) live in actions.json.
_opening_comment: gauge_spread_percent: each unit starts a fight with a gauge drawn from the fight's seed, 0 to this percent of a turn. 0 starts everyone empty (no draw). Scenarios may set their own (data/scenarios, opening_gauge_spread_percent): the S9 sandbox does, so its fixed enemies differ per seed. TODO(decision: sandbox-seed-variation)
_player_skills_comment: Skills of a squad member whose summary lists no skills (old saves, tools, tests). Drafted bots fight with their own skills through bot_skill_effects instead.
_basic_attack_comment: Every squad member keeps this single-target attack: it is added, first, when the bot's own skills do not include it. It costs energy like every action but Wait (decided Nov 2; its cost is in actions.json); a unit that cannot afford it waits, which is always free. The strike-cost switch (data/variants/variants.json) sets the recharge that goes with it, and its retired free option makes it cost 0 again for comparisons.
_bot_skill_effects_comment: Bot skill effect_id (data/bot_data/skills.json) -> the combat skill it fights with. setup_shred (Shred) is not in the draft catalog (questions row 19); only Battle Mode's Rework kit preset holds it. The bot's name and level for the skill carry over; cost, power, effect and target come from actions.json.
_stagger_comment: Plating and Stagger (fight/stagger_rules.gd). A plated enemy (archetypes.json plating) loses pips_per_hit pips per hit, pips_per_matching_hit when the hit's damage_type matches its plating_weakness. At 0 it is Staggered: its wait is cancelled and its next turn is spent recovering, it is knocked back knockback_percent of a turn on the timeline, and hits on it deal damage_bonus_percent more. Recovering puts back recover_percent of its plating (0: it stays unplated).
